newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Tajik president leaves for talks in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Tajik president leaves for talks in Afghanistan.

text.p: Tajikistan President Imomali Rakhmonov left on Tuesday for peace talks with the leader of the country's Islamist opposition in northern Afghanistan as further violence rocked the former Soviet republic.
Airport officials in the Tajik capital Dushanbe confirmed Rakhmonov's departure for Afghanistan early on Tuesday.
The Tajik Interior Ministry said one government soldier was killed and another wounded in a shootout with opposition guerrillas nearly three km (two miles) east of Dushanbe late on Monday.
"We carried out a raid on a suspected opposition base in Dzhangalabad when the shooting occurred," said a ministry spokesman.
Guerrilla comander Nazar Sanginov was killed in the raid and three opposition fighters were captured, he added.
